text:
Clinica-ML: Hey team—requesting onboarding for a clinical triage model. Constraints: no PHI leak in outputs, must support adding ~9k domain tokens, target p95 <= 300ms, ~20 rps. Prefer private VPC deployment. Can you advise next steps?

Maya (CSM): Thanks—capturing. Tagging @Ravi for technical compatibility and @Tess for privacy/safety. Renewal check: customer on annual plan, renewal in ~45 days, so fast path recommended.

Ravi (SE): Quick checks: 1) Do you have a finalized token list or a draft? 2) Will you provide redacted samples and expected labels for triage mapping? Token additions can change the tokenizer indices; if we finalize token map early it reduces churn.

Clinica-ML (customer): We have a draft CSV (about 9k tokens) and 1.5k sample prompts. We'll upload to secure link. Also want assurances on disabled token logs and KMS for model artifacts.

onboard-bot: Secure upload ready: https://files.redwood.com/secure-upload/clinica-045 (expires in 7 days).

Tess (Safety): Flagged for PHI. Requirements: tenant-level raw token logging disabled, mandatory KMS key for stored artifacts, access audit logs retained, and a prompt-injection and hallucination eval before production. Please complete the safety intake: https://redwood.inc/safety-templates/clinica.

Ravi (SE): Plan: I'll run a conversion/tokenization check on a Dedicated staging instance first, then mirror to Private VPC tests. Need from customer: token CSV, samples (1.5k), and a small model artifact if available. ETA initial compat report: Tue EOD.

Jordan (RevOps): Noted renewal timeline. I'll create a renewal-watch ticket and add onboarding milestones as acceptance criteria so contract team is aligned.

Maya (CSM): Proposed kickoff: Tue 11am PT. I'll send calendar invite and include checklist: safety signoff, p95 <=300ms, KMS validation, token map ingestion.

Ravi (SE): Example staging eval command (for clarity):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/eval \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"cases":"s3://secure-upload/clinica/samples.jsonl","metrics":["p95_latency","label_accuracy","hallucination_rate"]}'
```

Clinica-ML (customer): Uploading now. Please confirm token-level logs are off and that we can require HSM wrapping if needed.

Tess (Safety): Confirmed: raw token logging will be disabled for this tenant. KMS is required; HSM wrap optional but supported. We'll run the safety eval once samples are processed.

Maya (CSM): Action items: Ravi -> compat report (Tue EOD), Tess -> safety intake review (Mon), Jordan -> renewal-watch ticket, Clinica -> upload token CSV + samples, Maya -> kickoff invite. Updating thread with progress.

Clinica-ML (customer): Great—see upload complete. Thanks! :thumbsup:

Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone—we'll post updates here after the staging run and safety review.
